source: NetApp press release: NetApp and Oracle to Launch Fully Managed Cloud Storage (09-29-2026)

quarterly_data.quarter: NetApp press release: NetApp and Oracle to Launch Fully Managed Cloud Storage (09-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: NetApp and Oracle announced Oracle Cloud Infrastructure NetApp Storage Service, a fully managed OCI-native storage service bringing NetApp ONTAP data management capabilities to OCI, managed through the OCI Console and SDKs, ONTAP APIs and familiar operational workflows, for databases, enterprise applications, virtualized environments, EDA/HPC, regulated applications, and AI data pipelines. Release: 'OCI NetApp Storage Service is planned for general availability within the next 12 months.' Planned, not yet available.
quarterly_data.figure: general availability planned within the next 12 months
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: partner (first-party cloud storage service on OCI)
